prompt:
Look at the dose-response curve image provided. It shows a sigmoidal curve of concentration (nM, x-axis, log scale) vs response (%, y-axis). Guide lines are drawn at 50% response and at the IC50 value. Estimate the IC50 value (the concentration at which response equals 50%) from the plot.

Return a JSON object with one key: 'ic50' (numeric, in nM).
